text: APPROVE. The extracted `TargetsRemovedElement` is the exact negation of the original `continue` conditions, and `ReplacesIndicator` keeps the same `DrawsIndicator` check followed by `!ReferenceEquals(rule, removing) && OutlineEffect(...) is false && Outranks(...)`. The `Where` and `Any` calls preserve ordering and short-circuiting, so behaviour is unchanged. The nesting is now two loops, one `if` and one `&&`, which is well under 15. `System.Linq` is already in use via `Select`, and I see nothing that would break the build.
